## Activity

During March 2021, Market Eye Clinic completed 306 captures. This activity represents the recorded screening output for the month. The available information indicates that session lists ran as planned, apart from routine leave. No further operational exceptions are recorded in the report. The capture total provides the basis for the image quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 306 captures, 15 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.9 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the graded outcomes. The image quality position should therefore be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing monthly performance.

## Grading

There were 61 referable results. The median grading wait was 1 day. This measure records the central grading turnaround for the month and should be read with the reported activity and image quality figures. Overall, the report records the volume of captures, the number that were ungradable, the ungradable rate, the referable results and the median grading wait for Market Eye Clinic during March 2021.
